index_mapping: Determine the low-grid orbital-frequency peak by argmax of gradient(low phase, low time); prospectively require it to be the final low-grid sample, then interpolate wheel dynamics at continuous wheel mode times referenced to that peak. No rounded index.
interpretation_limit: A same-wheel-trajectory coefficient-factor sensitivity measures how much of the source/wheel mode difference is explained by substituting NQC coefficients under one approximated low-grid evaluation. It cannot prove source/wheel build or dynamics causality.
intervention: On the fixed installed-wheel trajectory and mode, replace only the evaluated NQC factor by multiplying the wheel mode by source_factor/wheel_factor. Source mode remains the reference. No phase/time/amplitude fitting.
prospective_gates: Exact tuple, source tag/commit/files/headers, wheel versions/libraries, and hashed inputs

Source and wheel epochs agree within 1e-4M and continuous low mapping is within 0.25 sample of low grid
Low-grid orbital-frequency peak equals final low sample
Fields/factors finite and physically signed; correction window before low orbital peak
